source.text: tantrasāra, pañcadaśam āhnikam yadā punar āsannamaraṇasya svayaṃ vā bandhumukhena śaktipāta upajāyate tadā asmai sadyaḥ samutkramaṇadīkṣāṃ kuryāt // abhts_15.1 samastam adhvānaṃ śiṣye nyasya taṃ ca krameṇa śodhayitvā bhagavatīṃ kālarātrīm marmakartanīṃ nyasya tayā kramāt kramaṃ marmapāśān vibhidya brahmarandhravarti śiṣyacaitanyaṃ kuryāt // abhts_15.2 tataḥ pūrvoktakrameṇa yojanikārthaṃ pūrṇāhutiṃ dadyāt yathā pūrṇāhutyante jīvo niṣkrāntaḥ paramaśivābhinno bhavati // abhts_15.3 bubhukṣos tu dvitīyā pūrṇāhutiḥ // abhts_15.4 bhogasthāne yojanāya tatkāle ca tasya jīvalayaḥ nātra śeṣavartanam brahmavidyāṃ vā karṇe paṭhet sā hi parāmarśasvabhāvā sadyaḥ prabuddhapaśucaitanye prabuddhavimarśaṃ karoti // abhts_15.5 samayyāder api ca etatpāṭhe 'dhikāraḥ // abhts_15.6 sapratyayāṃ nirbījāṃ tu yadi dīkṣāṃ mūḍhāya āyātaśaktipātāya ca darśayet tadā hi śivahastadānakāle ayaṃ vidhiḥ trikoṇam āgneyaṃ jvālākarālaṃ rephavisphuliṅgaṃ bahirvātyācakradhyāyamānaṃ maṇḍalaṃ dakṣiṇahaste cintayitvā tatraiva haste bījaṃ kiṃcit nikṣipya ūrdhvādhorephavibodhitaphaṭkāraparamparābhiḥ asya tāṃ jananaśaktiṃ dahet evaṃ kurvan taṃ hastaṃ śiṣyasya mūrdhani kṣipet iti dvayor api eṣā dīkṣā nirbījā svakāryakaraṇasāmarthyavidhvaṃsinī bhavati sthāvarāṇām api dīkṣyatvena uktatvāt vāyupurāntarvyavasthitaṃ dodhūyamānaṃ śiṣyaṃ laghūbhūtaṃ cintayet yena tulayā laghuḥ dṛśyate iti // abhts_15.7

l1_text:
## tsa15-p01
But when for near-death one, by self or through kin-mouth, descent arises — then for him instant ascent-initiation one should do. (15.1) The whole course in pupil placed, and in course purified, goddess Time-night, marrow-cutting, placed, through her in course marrow-bonds split, Brahma-hole-abiding pupil-consciousness one should make. (15.2) Then by before-told-course for joining-sake full offering one should give — so that at full-offering-end, life gone forth becomes supreme-Śiva-undivided. (15.3) But of enjoyer-wisher is second full offering. (15.4) For enjoyment-place joining; and at that time of him is life-dissolution; here is no remaining conduct. And brahma-knowledge in ear one should recite — for it, grasping-natured, instantly in awakened-beast-consciousness makes awakened grasping. (15.5) Of samayin-and-rest too in this reciting is entitlement. (15.6) But marked seedless, if for fool and descent-come one shows initiation — then in Śiva-hand-gift-time this is the course: triangle southeast flame-terrible phaṭ-spark outer-wind-wheel-contemplated maṇḍala in right hand contemplated — therein seed something cast — by up-down-phaṭ-awakened series his birth-power burning — thus doing, that hand on pupil's crown one should throw — thus of both too this initiation seedless, own-work-doing-power-destroying becomes. Of immovables too, through being stated as to-be-initiated — wind-city-abiding trembling pupil light-made contemplated — whereby by balance light is seen. (15.7)
l2_text:
## tsa15-p01 — for the dying, and seedless grace
Death near, grace come — by himself or a kinsman's mouth: the instant ascent-rite. Lay the whole course in the pupil and cleanse it; set Time-night, marrow-cutter; cut the marrow-bonds joint by joint; seat his awareness at Brahmā's hole. Then the joining full-offering as before — till at its end the life goes out Lord-undivided. Enjoyers get a second full-offering (their station, their life melting then; no conduct after). Whisper brahma-knowledge in his ear — grasping-natured, it wakes grasping in the just-waked beast-mind. Samayins too may hear it read. The marked seedless — for dullards and the graced: at Śiva's hand-gift, picture in the right palm a southeast triangle, flame-grim, phaṭ-sparking, ringed with outer wind-wheels; drop in a seed; burn his birth-power with phaṭ upon phaṭ kindled up and down; clap that hand on his crown. Seedless for both — wrecking the power to make its own work. Even the unmoving may be raised: picture the trembling pupil hung in wind's city, grown light — light on the scales to see.

Near death, grace come — by himself or a kinsman's mouth: the instant ascent-rite. Lay the whole course in the pupil and cleanse it; set Time-night, marrow-cutter; cut the marrow-bonds joint by joint; seat his awareness at Brahmā's hole. Then the joining full-offering as before — till at its end the life goes out Lord-undivided. Enjoyers get a second full-offering (their station, their life melting then; no conduct after). Whisper brahma-knowledge in his ear — grasping-natured, it wakes grasping in the just-waked beast-mind. Samayins too may hear it read. The marked seedless — for dullards and the graced: at Śiva's hand-gift, picture in the right palm a southeast triangle, flame-grim, phaṭ-sparking, ringed with outer wind-wheels; drop in a seed; burn his birth-power with phaṭ upon phaṭ kindled up and down; clap that hand on his crown. The passage moves in two parts. First, sadyaḥ: near-death with descent-arisen → whole course placed/purified → Kālarātrī marrow-cutter placed → marrow-bonds split → Brahma-hole consciousness made → joining full-offering → life gone forth Lord-undivided; enjoyer-wisher gets second full-offering (life-dissolution; no remaining conduct); brahmavidyā in ear (grasping-natured, wakes grasping in awakened-beast-consciousness); samayins too entitled. Second, nirbījā: marked seedless for fool/descent-come → Śiva-hand-gift rite (triangle southeast flame-terrible phaṭ-spark outer-wind-wheel maṇḍala in right hand, seed cast, up-down-phaṭ series burning birth-power, hand thrown on crown) = seedless for both, own-work-power-destroying; immovables initiable (wind-city-abiding, trembling, light-made, balance-light).
c1.terms: sadyaḥ (instant), samutkramaṇa (ascent), kālarātrī (Time-night), marmakartanī (marrow-cutter), brahmarandhra (Brahma-hole), nirbījā (seedless), Śiva-hasta (Śiva-hand).
c1.function: Two rites for urgency and incapacity: instant ascent (sadyaḥ) and seedless initiation (nirbījā).
